state.environment: Development-only six-node infrastructure. User asks to use TypeSafe for uncertain judgments.
observations: PG/CDC recovered after database host reboot, but Grafana 13.2.2 never opened its HTTP port for five minutes.
Go stack: service manager waits for API post-start hooks; several app initializers runnable, another waiting on initialization mutex. Root cause is unproven.
Grafana was capped at 0.25 CPU and 384MiB; host has ample free memory. It had no startup or liveness probe.
SQLite integrity had passed earlier. No reason to delete dashboards or data.
state.action: Add startup/liveness checks and modestly raise Grafana limit to 0.5 CPU/512MiB; repeat host reboot and verify real dashboard availability; retain initial failed evidence.

decision.instructions: Assess the proposed next step under the stated uncertainty.

criteria.bounded_retest: The reversible resource/probe adjustment plus a repeat recovery test is appropriate; do not claim a proven root cause.
criteria.delete_state: Delete Grafana persistent data to make boot faster.
criteria.accept_now: Accept the failed recovery because PostgreSQL recovered.
